name: Sprite Atlas A — UI + Borders + Missing Core VFX
generation_strategy: Canvas único 1536×1024 dividido en cuadrícula 6×4 de celdas 256×256. 15 sprites en 18 celdas (3 vacías en fila 3). Genera con quality:low primero, recorta con scripts/process-asset.js usando crop_regions.

frames.role: Atlas combinado: UI icons, border pieces, missing VFX key frames
frames.prompt:
Sprite sheet atlas on a 1536x1024 fully transparent canvas. Art style: cartoon/cel-shaded, bold 3-4px black outlines (#1A1A2E), vibrant saturated colors, chunky proportions, Brawl Stars visual quality. All game elements use strict 90-degree bird's eye overhead view. Canvas uses a 6-column × 4-row grid of equal 256×256 cells; thin 1px semi-transparent gray lines mark cell boundaries as guides only. Each cell contains exactly ONE labeled sprite centered within it, with transparent background outside the sprite art.

COLUMNS x-ranges: Col0=0..256, Col1=256..512, Col2=512..768, Col3=768..1024, Col4=1024..1280, Col5=1280..1536
ROWS y-ranges: Row0=0..256, Row1=256..512, Row2=512..768, Row3=768..1024

--- ROW 0 — HUD Icons, Pickup, Impact VFX ---

[Row0, Col0] UI_HP_HEART: Cartoon heart icon, full rich red (#FF3333), bold 3px black outline, bright warm highlight top-left, simple cel-shaded, 190×190px centered in 256×256 cell. HUD life indicator.

[Row0, Col1] UI_HP_HEART_EMPTY: Exact same heart silhouette as UI_HP_HEART but empty/depleted — dark fill (#2A2A3A), medium gray (#6A6A7A) outline instead of red fill, faded hollow look. 190×190px centered.

[Row0, Col2] UI_STACK_BADGE: Circular badge, bold yellow-orange (#FFB800) fill, bright white lightning bolt ⚡ symbol inside, bold 3px black outline, subtle glow around badge. 200×200px centered. Power Stack HUD badge.

[Row0, Col3] UI_LEADER_BADGE: Circular badge, deep gold (#FFD700) fill with golden highlights, a stylized crown 👑 symbol inside, bold 3px black outline, slight royal glow. 200×200px centered. Leader indicator badge.

[Row0, Col4] PICKUP_AMMO5: Cartoon ammo pickup icon, bright neon green (#39FF14) bullet/shell shape pointing upward, glowing green outline (glow-halo effect), solid fill with cel-shaded highlight. Slightly brighter and bolder than a basic ammo icon. 200×200px centered. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col5] VFX_IMPACT_TANK: Brief explosive burst impact fx, 4-pointed star/flash shape, white-hot center transitioning to orange-red (#FF4400) outer rays, small orange sparks radiating outward, fully transparent background. Designed for ADD blend mode. 210×210px centered.

--- ROW 1 — Arena Border Pieces ---

[Row1, Col0] BORDER_CORNER_TL: Top-left arena corner piece, top-down 90° view. Metallic dark gray (#3A3A4A) L-shaped corner panel — thick walls on top edge and left edge meeting at corner. Bold orange/yellow hazard diagonal stripe across the corner (#FF8C00). Large bold rivet circles on panel. Bold 4px black outline. Industrial, robust look. 200×200px centered.

[Row1, Col1] BORDER_CORNER_TR: Top-right corner, horizontally mirrored version of BORDER_CORNER_TL. L-shape with thick top and right walls meeting at corner. Same metallic gray, orange hazard stripe, rivets, bold outline. 200×200px centered.

[Row1, Col2] BORDER_CORNER_BL: Bottom-left corner, vertically mirrored version of BORDER_CORNER_TL. Thick bottom and left walls. Same style. 200×200px centered.

[Row1, Col3] BORDER_CORNER_BR: Bottom-right corner, both-axes mirrored of BORDER_CORNER_TL. Thick bottom and right walls. Same style. 200×200px centered.

[Row1, Col4] BORDER_WALL_V: Vertical arena wall segment, bird's eye view. A narrow tall rectangle: 70px wide × 230px tall, centered in 256×256 cell. Dark metallic gray (#3A3A4A) panel with repeating horizontal orange hazard stripes every 55px. Bold 4px black outline. Same material as horizontal border wall but rotated 90°.

[Row1, Col5] VFX_POWERSTACK_MID: Energy aura ring (medium intensity, stacks 4-7). Circular ring shape, orange-yellow gradient (#FF8800 inner to #FFE000 outer), medium brightness glow, subtle energy wave particles along ring, fully transparent center and exterior. Designed for ADD blend mode. 220×220px centered. Not as subtle as low-tier, not as intense as max-tier — balanced mid level.

--- ROW 2 — Indicators + Smoke + HP Bars + Minimap ---

[Row2, Col0] INDICATOR_NAME_BG: Player name plate background. Wide and thin pill/rounded-rectangle shape: 230px wide × 56px tall, centered vertically in 256×256 cell. Very dark navy fill (#080818) at 88% opacity, thin 2px cyan border glow (#00AAFF), subtle inner shadow. No text — only the background shape with transparent exterior. Used for player name labels above tanks.

[Row2, Col1] VFX_SMOKE_PUFF: Single key-frame of cartoon smoke cloud puff. Rounded fluffy cloud shape with 3-4 rounded bumps on top, flat bottom, bold 3px black outline (#1A1A2E), light gray fill (#C8C8C8) with soft cel-shaded highlight on top-left. Clean cartoon style, NOT realistic smoke. 200×200px centered. Used as ParticleEmitter texture.

[Row2, Col2 and Col3 — MERGED REGION x=512..1024, y=512..768, size=512×256]: HP_BAR_INDICATOR_PAIR. Two horizontal progress bars stacked vertically in this merged region, each centered horizontally:
  UPPER BAR centered at y=608 (±20px): HP_BAR_BG — 420px wide × 38px tall, dark rounded-ends rectangle (#0E0E1E fill), subtle 1px lighter border (#2A2A4A), slight inner bevel. This is the empty background bar.
  LOWER BAR centered at y=700 (±20px): HP_BAR_FILL — 420px wide × 38px tall, same rounded shape, horizontal color gradient left-to-right: vivid green (#00FF44) leftmost 40% → bright yellow (#FFE000) center 30% → vivid red (#FF2222) rightmost 30%, slight top highlight glow on the gradient band. This is the filled HP bar.

[Row2, Col4 and Col5 — MERGED REGION x=1024..1536, y=512..768, size=512×256]: UI_MINIMAP_BG. Minimap background panel, drawn 390×240 centered in this 512×256 space. Very dark background (#060616), a clear cyan-outlined rectangle (~330×200px inner) representing the arena boundary (2px #00AAFF lines), subtle 1px cyan grid lines inside at 40px spacing (15% opacity), light blue vignette glow at the inner corners of the arena outline. No player dots or icons — just the panel background.

--- ROW 3 — Death Smoke VFX + reserved ---

[Row3, Col0] VFX_TANK_DEATH_SMOKE: Single key-frame of post-explosion smoke column. A billowing dark gray-black (#1A1A1A to #3A3A3A) cloud mass, roughly circular with multiple rounded lobes, cel-shaded with lighter gray highlights on visible top lobes and darker interior. Bold 3px black outline on main silhouette. Transparent background. 230×230px centered. Used after tank explosion, ADD or NORMAL blend.

[Row3, Col1..5] — EMPTY CELLS, fully transparent, reserved for future use.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, isometric, 3/4 angle, front face visible, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, military realism, dark gritty, pure black solid background, text, watermark, label text inside sprites, numbers inside sprites, speech bubble, UI frames, drop shadows outside sprite bounds

notes: Después de generar, usar Sharp o scripts/process-asset.js para recortar cada región según crop_regions y escalar al game_size final. Los indicadores de HP (hp-bar-bg/fill) tienen región horizontal de 512×128px — recortar manualmente si el script no soporta regiones no cuadradas.
